title: Systemic fusidic acid and interaction with statins
authors: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
journal: MHRA Drug Safety Update, volume 5, issue 2, September 2011
funder: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
result: The number and severity of case reports of rhabdomyolysis, including fatal cases, suspected to be due to an interaction between systemic fusidic acid and a statin had increased; the mechanism is unknown and could apply to some or all statins. Systemic fusidic acid should not be given with statins; where it is essential, statin treatment should be stopped for its duration and reintroduced 7 days after the last dose.
